rv.q: Jon Brittain's transgender tale is a very good romantic comedy indeed, full of laughs and sadness and knotty ideas that it untangles with enormous empathy alongside a fizzing sense of fun.
Nevertheless this production is not flawless.

cn.t: Critics are divided on this transgender romantic comedy: some praise its empathetic handling of knotty ideas with humor and heart, while others find it falls short despite its ambitious premise.
